newsitem.title: UK: IPE Brent crude stalls, lacks fresh direction.
newsitem.headline: IPE Brent crude stalls, lacks fresh direction.

text.p: IPE Brent crude stalled in early afternoon trade on Friday amid a lack of fresh fundamental direction, brokers said.
July Brent crude was trading 12 cents lower at $19.36 a barrel by 1431 GMT, towards the lower end of the session's narrow 13-cent range but barely unchanged from midday levels.
"There's a precious lack of volume and a precious lack of interest at the moment," said a broker.
Support at $19.30 a barrel on July Brent looked solid and dealers saw little reason for a break lower after a week of consolidation following Tuesday's 78-cent fall.
Even the expiry of NYMEX June unleaded gasoline and heating oil contracts was generating little volatility, brokers said.
June heating oil added 0.25 cents to 56.25 cents a gallon by 1440 GMT, while unleaded gasoline dropped a cent to 64.15 cents a gallon.
Meanwhile, IPE gas oil was also drifting lower in extremely thin volume depressed by an absence of industry players in Germany and extremely warm weather through much of Europe.
June gas oil shed $1.25 to $173 a tonne by 1442 GMT, slipping further into contango as July lost $1 to $174.25.
